units: <cite ref="Chullin 105b:4">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>ומשתכח כי ק׳ בכורא</he> it (the injurious kind of Sodomitic salt) is found in the proportion of one grain in a Kor; a. e.—Pl. <he>קוֹרְטִין</he>, <he>קוֹרְטֵי</he>.
Ib. 43ᵇ תרי ק׳ דמא two drops of coagulated blood; a. e.—Trnsf. a man of minute weight, pigmy.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite> <he>פישון</he> … <he>ננסא ק׳ קטוע פושכא</he> Ms. Par. quot. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>קרטא</he>; ed. only <he>פישון זו בבל</he>) Pishon (<cite ref="Genesis 2:11">Gen. II, 11</cite>) refers to Babel, (Nebuchadnezzar) the dwarf, the pigmy, the stunted, of the size of a hand-breadth (v. Yalk. Dan. 1062, quot. s. v. <cite ref="Q00403"><he>פּוּשְׁקָא</he></cite>).
